reviews.title: App stopped working for me
reviews.text:
Without warning this app has stopped working for me and is asking me to upgrade to premium membership. 
Before that I loved being able to track my walks and it encouraged me to go a little further.

reviews.title: Does the trick!
reviews.text: I have used this app now for 2 marathon’s and 3 1/2M and whether I used the full app or the free it does the trick! Always nice to have the regular voice update the full app provides! 😉

reviews.title: Seems great - dirty practices
reviews.text: The app seems excellent so far but I noticed it seems to go out of its way to prevent spotify from playing in the background on your cellular apple watch. I get they want you to pay for premium but it seems like they're doing something to make sure spotify does not play and your restricted to apple music

reviews.title: Lacks accountability
reviews.text: If I suddenly go 10xs faster than I was after the first 10-15 minutes of walking, you need to shout in my ear like the other time yall do, & tell me if the question of if I want to continue or not.

reviews.title: Doesn't work with fitbit
reviews.text: Wanted an app that works with my fitbit charge 6. It connects to it but somehow it shows my heart rate as around 33000, and after finished it says my average heart rate was -22000. So its basically useless

reviews.title: Nur eingeschränkt nutzbar
reviews.text: Seit einiger Zeit leider nur teilweise unbrauchbar. Verbindung von iPhone zu Apple Watch nicht durchgängig gegeben, die Verbindung muss immer wieder neu aufgebaut werden und der Herzschlag kann so natürlich nicht präzise wiedergegeben werden. Der Kundenservice ist leider auch nicht fähig das Problem zu lösen, man bekommt nur vorgefertige Ratschläge ohne echtes Wissen. So leider nur bedingt nutzbar. Muss mich wohl nach etwas anderem umsehen.
